alerts.title: Using Gemma4 with Ollama - Testing File Hash Analysis and Recommendations with AI, (Wed, Aug 12th)
alerts.description: In the past few weeks, I have been using Gemma4 as a Large Language Model (LLM) to see how useful it can be to analyze some of the malware hashes uploaded to the DShield sensor over the past 30 days and figure out how its recommendation can be considered useful about the activity my DShield sensor is collecting and tracking. The model I use for this testing is gemma4:e4b [ 2 ] using two sites to compare the data against VirusTotal and CyberGordon .

alerts.title: Verizon offers $25K reward for information in vandalism case that caused widespread SoCal outage
alerts.description: Verizon is offering a $25,000 reward for information leading to the arrest and conviction of those responsible for cutting fiber cables over the weekend, causing a widespread outage across SoCal.

alerts.title: What is credit card skimming, and how can you protect yourself?
alerts.description: A form of credit card theft known as skimming is on the rise as thieves install their own card readers to steal your information and money. It's a particular threat to users of EBT cards. Carter Evans reports on how to spot them and protect yourself.

alerts.title: Two killed in military helicopter crash in Texas
alerts.description: Two soldiers died after the military helicopter they were in crashed into a field in Texas, northwest of Austin. It's unclear what caused the Apache chopper, based at Fort Hood, to go down Wednesday afternoon. The crash also sparked a large fire, forcing some evacuations. NBC News' Morgan Chesky reports.

alerts.title: JPS Health Network outage continues. Here's how to fill your prescriptions
alerts.description: JPS Health Network patient access to MyChart has been down since at least Aug. 3, preventing patients from checking appointment schedules or refilling medication. JPS initially said it was experiencing an outage affecting several patient resources, including online services and phone lines, and was working to restore service ASAP. On Aug. 4, JPS remained under a “controlled network downtime.” Meanwhile, the hospital, JPS clinics, and care locations were open and treating patients. On Friday, Aug. 7, JPS revealed new details about the problem, saying they had identified suspicious activity with the “technology environment.” JPS decided to take down network systems. alerts.title: Man, woman killed in domestic shooting incident; relationship yet to be revealed
alerts.description: A man and a woman are dead after a fatal shooting that stemmed from a domestic disturbance in Denton on Sunday afternoon. Denton police said the shooting happened around 2:35 p.m. when authorities responded to the 1900 block of N. Bell Avenue after receiving reports of a shooting. First responders found a man and woman with apparent gunshot wounds when they arrived at the scene. Both were declared dead at the scene, officials said. Police said this appears to be an isolated incident with no threat to the public. Officials plan to release the victims’ identities and the relationship between them once their next-of-kin have been notified of their deaths. The shooting investigation is ongoing.

alerts.title: #StopRansomware: Gunra Ransomware
alerts.description: Advisory at a Glance Title #StopRansomware: Gunra Ransomware Original Publication August 10, 2026 Executive Summary Gunra is a ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) used by affiliates to target government, critical infrastructure, and other organizations. The Gunra ransomware variant first appeared in 2025 and expanded to RaaS operations in 2026. The actors leverage a double-extortion model, both encrypting data and threatening to publish exfiltrated data to a dedicated leak site (DLS) if the ransom is not paid. This advisory provides technical details of the activity, as well as tailored detection and mitigation guidance to protect at-risk organizations from Gunra. Key Actions Prioritize patching known exploited vulnerabilities in internet-facing systems , including virtual private network (VPN)

alerts.title: Malicious Cyber Actors Targeting Water and Wastewater Sector Internet- Facing Programmable Logic Controllers, Causing Operational Disruptions
alerts.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) are issuing this Public Service Announcement (PSA) to warn critical infrastructure asset owners and operators that malicious cyber actors (MCAs) are conducting cyber attacks targeting Operational Technology (OT) devices, including Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), specifically MicroLogix 1100 and 1400 series. Since 27 July 2026, Water and Wastewater Sector (WWS) utility companies in at least seven states have reported incidents to the FBI, and some of that activity degraded water operations. While the FBI has only observed this behavior with the referenced Rockwell PLCs, similar considerations should also be made with other branded PLCs.

alerts.title: Countering Chinese State-Sponsored Actors Compromise of Networks Worldwide to Feed Global Espionage System
alerts.description: Executive summary People’s Republic of China (PRC) state-sponsored cyber threat actors are targeting networks globally, including, but not limited to, telecommunications, government, transportation, lodging, and military infrastructure networks. While these actors focus on large backbone routers of major telecommunications providers, as well as provider edge (PE) and customer edge (CE) routers, they also leverage compromised devices and trusted connections to pivot into other networks. These actors often modify routers to maintain persistent, long-term access to networks.  This activity partially overlaps with cyber threat actor reporting by the cybersecurity industry—commonly referred to as Salt Typhoon, OPERATOR PANDA, RedMike, UNC5807, and GhostEmperor, among others. alerts.description: Summary The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) and U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) are issuing this Cybersecurity Advisory to present findings from a recent CISA and USCG hunt engagement. The purpose of this advisory is to highlight identified cybersecurity issues, thereby informing security defenders in other organizations of potential similar issues and encouraging them to take proactive measures to enhance their cybersecurity posture. This advisory has been coordinated with the organization involved in the hunt engagement.
